plan.title: Closed RFQ Master QCS Report Download

steps.note: Open Master QCS for the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A's bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the RFQ state.
Enable partial awarding as required by the case configuration.
Disable the bid-unlock restriction required by the case.
Keep over-awarding disabled as required by the case configuration.
Activate the Master QCS report download control.
Verify the expected progress message appears after clicking Download Report.
